published.source: PR #54 (client 70425: Judgement of Righteousness 42.9%, Champion of the Light 10 / 20 / 30%, Consecration 4.2% a tick; Concentration Aura; Human, 2026-10-16)

summary: Retribution down to Twist of Light with Precision 3 from Protection and Divine Strength, Divine Intellect and Improved Seals in Holy, twisting Seal of Command and Seal of Righteousness before every swing. This copy is on Judgement of the Crusader duty: it keeps the debuff on the boss for the raid instead of getting it from another paladin.
rotation: Pre-pull: Seal of Righteousness at -4.5 s, Seal of Command at -3 s, Seal of the Crusader at -1.5 s (replacing Command leaves its Echo for the first swing)
Judgement of the Crusader at the pull (the duty): 161 Holy damage taken for 40 s, refreshed by the paladin's own melee hits, so one cast lasts the fight; judged again only if it drops
Consecration on cooldown while mana is at or above 20%
Judgement on cooldown on whichever damage seal is up
Seal of Command whenever no damage seal is up

Twist: with Seal of Command up, swap to Seal of Righteousness in the last 1.5 s before a swing, and back to Command before the next swing (one swap per swing, down to 20% mana); Twist of Light's Echo applies the old seal on the next swing
Racials, Goblin Sapper, Major Mana Potion and Demonic Rune on free GCDs
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 32 spell power and 18 crit rating, and 140 spell power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Twisting is worth 126 DPS, Consecration 109, Holy Strike 99, Hammer of Wrath 29 at 180 s (measured before client 70425)
Human is best since client 70425 (Ruthless, 2% crit with any weapon): about 3 ahead of Undead (Touch of the Grave) at 180 s
A second crit elixir (Mongoose) would add 14.9 DPS; one 2% crit elixir per character by ruling
Holy Strike's flat part inside the 50% weapon percent comes from client data, not yet confirmed on the beta
High Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be stale: holding them to their level 30 trend would cost about 1.2%
Seal of Righteousness spell power counted twice on a two-hander (SoD-style 2 x 11%); one coefficient would be about 50-54 DPS lower, and client 70425's 0 on the proc spells about 98-105 lower
Two-Handed Weapon Specialization applied to Holy seal damage (Era sim choice vs client Physical mask): about -11 if removed
Synthetic gear on the hybrid budget (only the Justice Battlegear 2-piece live)
The request has the raid's Judgement of the Crusader off, so the debuff comes only from this paladin (standards 23).
notes: Request: paladin__level_60 with raid debuff judgementOfTheCrusader removed and the level60_crusader_duty rotation.
